onePointFour.intro: A previous version of BolinhoMod, version 1.4, is still available for download.
onePointFour.introNote: {noteLabel} You can still share projects from 1.4 to the BolinhoMod website. However, projects created in newer versions of BolinhoMod cannot be opened in 1.4.
onePointFour.windowsBody: Compatible with Windows 2000, XP, Vista, 7, and 8
onePointFour.resourcesQ: What resources are available to help me learn how to use BolinhoMod 1.4?
onePointFour.resourcesA: For a step-by-step introduction, download the {gettingStartedGuide}. The {referenceGuide} has a thorough explanation of the BolinhoMod interface and programming language. {scratchCards} provide brief explanations that show how to make animations and interactive projects with BolinhoMod.
onePointFour.requirementsQ: What are the system requirements for BolinhoMod 1.4?
onePointFour.requirementsDisplay: Display: 800 x 480 or larger, thousands or millions of colors (16-bit color or greater)
onePointFour.requirementsOS: Operating System: Windows 2000 or later, Mac OS X 10.4 through 10.14, Ubuntu Linux 9.04 or later (For other versions of Linux, see the Linux Installer page)
onePointFour.requirementsDisk: Disk: at least 120 megabytes of free space to install BolinhoMod.
onePointFour.requirementsCPUMemory: CPU and memory: Most computers have enough memory to run BolinhoMod 1.4, but very old computers may run BolinhoMod slowly.
onePointFour.requirementsSoundVideo: Sound / Video: Sound playback requires speakers (or headphones), and recording requires a microphone. Many laptops have speakers and microphones built in. BolinhoMod 1.4 can use a USB or built-in camera (optional).
onePointFour.errorQ: What if I get an error when I try to upload or share my project to the BolinhoMod website?
onePointFour.errorFileTooBig: File too big. The largest file limit is 10 MB. To shrink the size of your BolinhoMod project, click the Edit menu > and select compress sounds, or compress images. If you have compressed sounds and your project still won't upload, try deleting some of the sounds to make it smaller.
onePointFour.errorInternet: Internet connection too slow and times out. Try making the file smaller. If that doesn't work, try connecting from a different computer or connection or web browser.
onePointFour.errorProxy: Proxy server getting in the way. Try an Internet connection that does not go through a proxy server, or configure BolinhoMod to use your proxy server.
onePointFour.errorLogin: Wrong username and password. Try logging into BolinhoMod website to make sure username and password are correct.
